created_duplicate: Created {{name}}. Another item in this folder has the same name; both were kept.
intro: Connect Google Drive to browse and open Markdown files.
read_only_reason: Drive opens read-only by default. Enable editing in Connections, then reload, or edit a local copy.
preview_limit: Relative links and images are unavailable for Drive documents.
unverified: Experimental: live account verification is still required.
secure_unavailable: Secure OS credential storage is unavailable. Sign-in is disabled.
name: Connection name
registration_help: Create a Google Desktop app client and enable the Drive API. These registration values do not grant access by themselves.
remove_confirm: Remove this connection and its stored credentials? Open tabs will stay open.
disconnected: This connection is disconnected. Your open documents remain available.
unsupported: Only Markdown files can be opened. Google Docs and other formats are unsupported.
error_auth: Sign in again to access Google Drive.
error_permission: You do not have permission to access this item.
error_missing: This item was deleted, trashed or is no longer visible.
error_network: Could not reach Google Drive. Check your connection and retry.
error_throttled: Google Drive is rate limiting requests. Wait before retrying.
error_quota: Google Drive quota has been exceeded.
error_conflict: The Drive file changed. Compare the versions or reload; your local edits are retained.
error_configuration: Google Drive configuration is invalid. Try reconnecting or contact the app maintainer.
error_unsupported: This file or operation is unsupported. Markdown files up to 4 MiB can be opened.
error_storage: Could not securely store or remove credentials. Check OS credential storage and disk access.
callback_body: Your browser has returned the sign-in response. MKEditor will confirm when your Google Drive connection is ready.
invalid_callback: Invalid or expired sign-in request. Return to MKEditor and try again.
default_unavailable: Google sign-in is unavailable in this build. Contact the app maintainer.
editing_intro: Connect read-only first. Enable editing separately to save Markdown files in My Drive.
editing_intro_description: You can browse and open files, but saving changes or creating Markdown files needs editing access. Enable it now and Google will ask for permission to see, edit, create and delete your Drive files. You can also enable editing later in Settings → Connections.
editing_permission: Google will request permission to see, edit, create and delete all your Drive files. MKEditor uses this access to browse folders and save Markdown files you choose. Continue to Google?
shared_read_only: Shared-drive documents are read-only. Make a local copy to edit.
reload_confirm: Replace your unsaved edits with the latest Drive contents? Make a local copy first if you want to keep your edits.
error_unconfirmed: Google may have saved the file. Check its contents before trying another write; your local buffer is retained.
error_duplicate: A file with this name already exists. Choose another name; the existing file was not changed.
save_copy_help: Save the active tab’s current content as a new file in this Drive folder, including local files, untitled drafts and unsaved edits.
operation_unconfirmed: Google has not confirmed this change. Check the operation before trying again.
recovery_storage_error: Could not save or read local recovery data. Existing recovery copies have been kept.
recovered_draft: Recovered local draft. Check Drive before saving.
error_not_applied: Google did not apply this operation. Your draft is retained.
error_pending_operation: Check the interrupted operation before making another change to this file.
recovery_quit_message: Your latest changes could not be saved locally. Quit anyway, or cancel to keep the app open?
storage_intro: Connect cloud storage to browse and edit Markdown files.

dropbox.registration_help: Register a Dropbox app with Full Dropbox access and enable public clients (PKCE). Redirect URI: http://127.0.0.1:53683/oauth/callback

dropbox.operation_unconfirmed: Dropboxhas not confirmed this change. Check the operation before trying again.
